feature_name: Streaming Manifest Writer for Document Exporter
description: Implement a streaming manifest writer that replaces the current in-memory manifest accumulation with incremental I/O operations to significantly reduce peak memory usage during large document exports. The solution should write manifest records to a temporary file and perform atomic replacement upon successful completion while maintaining existing functionality like JSON comparison and proper error handling.
functional_requirements: Create a new StreamingManifestWriter class that writes manifest.json records incrementally to a temporary file instead of accumulating them in memory
Implement atomic file replacement by renaming the temporary file to the final manifest.json only upon successful completion of the export process
Maintain support for the --compare-json option using BLAKE2b hash comparison for file integrity verification
Ensure proper error handling that discards temporary files on exceptions while preserving the original manifest file with its modification time unchanged
Integrate the new streaming writer into the existing document export command architecture without breaking existing export functionality
Include comprehensive tests to verify memory usage improvements and maintain backward compatibility with existing export workflows
